finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: expression with more than MAX_SIZE opening symbols
finding.assumptions: The stack size is fixed at MAX_SIZE and there is no check to prevent pushing more than MAX_SIZE elements.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for a guard against exceeding the stack capacity. The function push() contains an explicit overflow check at lines 25-28 that calls is_full() and exits if the stack is full. This prevents any buffer overflow from occurring. The reported trigger (expression with more than MAX_SIZE opening symbols) would cause the program to terminate before any overflow could happen, not to overflow the buffer.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The expressions are hardcoded and not user-controlled, but if they were, this could lead to OS command injection.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the sink is printf with a constant format string "%d\n" on lines 67-71. The untrusted source "expression" is only passed to is_balanced, which returns a boolean value. The boolean is then printed as an integer, not as a format string or command. No system(), exec(), or similar functions are invoked, and the expression is never concatenated into a command string. Therefore there is no path from untrusted input to an OS command execution.
